tasks.subject: Task 1: assets redirect and missing_metadata config
tasks.description:
**Goal:** both keys validate; missing_metadata outside redirect mode is an error.

**Verify:** uv run pytest tests/test_config.py -q && just check-types

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/ghr_pypi/config.py", "tests/test_config.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_config.py -q && just check-types", "acceptanceCriteria": ["AssetMode gains redirect", "error lists all three modes", "missing_metadata defaults to extract", "invalid value rejected", "outside redirect mode rejected", "mirror alias unaffected"]}
```
